question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Will-o-the-wisp
solution:
The correct answer is **"An unrealistic or unattainable goal."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"will-o-the-wisp"** refers to something that is elusive or unattainable. (कुछ ऐसा जो मायावी या अप्राप्य हो)

 
 
• **Example**: *He said that achieving a first rank is **will-o-the-wisp**__.*
 
 
 
• It can also refer to something that leads you on a wild goose chase or is a distraction from what is important.
 
• The term comes from a phenomenon in which a phosphorescent light appears at night over marshy ground, which people would try to follow but could never catch.
 
• Synonyms for **"will-o-the-wisp" include "delusion," "illusion," and "fantasy."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
